REASON: My prior routing stands. This is a closed-form combinatorics problem with a single verifiable answer — exactly the well-specified, clear-completion-criteria work Plover self-reports preferring. The models are essentially tied on relevant capability (MMLU-Pro and GPQA within noise; no eval category distinguishes pure reasoning), so preference alignment is the tiebreaker, and it favors Plover. Lapwing's strengths (Support Dialogue, generative latitude) don't apply to a determinate counting task.
